page: Microsoft Azure L4aos_v5 is a virtual machine within the Laosv5 server family, utilizing AMD processors and virtualized via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance provides 4 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 architecture, ensuring consistent compute allocation without resource sharing.

The hardware configuration includes 32.0 GB of system memory, which yields a high density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core. A defining characteristic of this server is its integrated storage capacity, offering 2880 GB of local storage alongside Premium Storage capability. This instance does not include graphics processing units or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

This resource profile is optimized for data-intensive operations. The combination of dense local storage and a 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes the server highly suitable for database hosting, transactional systems, and analytical workloads that benefit from large local scratch space and moderate memory footprints.
description: Microsoft Azure L4aos_v5 is a storage and memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Laosv5 family. Powered by an AMD processor and managed via Microsoft Hyper-V, this instance features 4 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs and 32.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. A key feature of this server is its massive 2880 GB of local storage, combined with Premium Storage capability. With no integrated GPUs and zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, this configuration is highly specialized for data-dense environments. It is engineered for workloads requiring significant local storage capacity and moderate memory, such as relational databases, NoSQL transactional systems, and local data processing tasks.
